title: Kotak Mahindra Bank Launches Hybrid Home Loan with 65-Month Fixed Rate Lock
summary: Kotak Bank launched hybrid home loan combining fixed and floating rates with fixed interest lock up to 65 months.

blocks.content: Kotak Bank launched hybrid home loan combining fixed and floating rates with fixed interest lock up to 65 months.

items: **Fixed Rate Lock:** Borrowers can lock interest rates for up to **65 months** before transitioning to floating rate.
**Product Structure:** Combines fixed and floating rates for salaried and self-employed borrowers across India.
